user.title: Connect Tether
user.description: Choose a direct local connection or Lovense Standard API pairing.

local.title: Direct local connection
local.description: Enable **Game Mode** in Lovense Remote and enter the address and port it shows.

data_description.host: The LAN address of the phone or PC running Lovense Remote, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.port: The HTTP port shown in Game Mode (20010 by default) or the HTTPS port (30010 by default).
data_description.use_https: Connect to the HTTPS port instead of plain HTTP.
data_description.verify_ssl: Lovense Remote uses a self-signed certificate on the LAN, so leave this off unless you have replaced it.

standard.title: Lovense Standard API
standard.description: Set the callback URL in your Lovense developer dashboard to this Home Assistant's `/api/tether/callback` endpoint before pairing.

data_description.developer_token: The developer token from the Lovense developer dashboard.
data_description.user_id: Any stable identifier for this Home Assistant user; it pairs callbacks with this entry.
data_description.user_name: The name Lovense Remote shows for this connection.
data_description.callback_url: The same callback URL saved in the Lovense developer dashboard. Its path must end in `/api/tether/callback`.

pair.title: Pair Lovense Remote

data.skip_pairing_check: Continue without waiting for the callback

data_description.skip_pairing_check: Only tick this if the callback URL cannot reach Home Assistant. Tether will then rely on the Lovense cloud API until Lovense Remote reaches the callback.

error.already_configured: Another Tether entry already uses this connection.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Lovense or the API rejected the request.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname without a URL path.
error.invalid_callback_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS callback URL.
error.pairing_not_received: Home Assistant has not received the pairing callback yet. Scan the QR code, wait a few seconds, then try again. Check that the callback URL in the Lovense developer dashboard matches and is reachable from your phone.

abort.already_configured: This Lovense connection is already configured.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to ask Lovense Remote for the toy list and battery levels.
data_description.default_time_sec: Duration used by services when no duration is given; 0 runs until stopped.
data_description.verify_ssl: Verify TLS certificates for HTTPS requests to Lovense Remote.
data_description.stroke_control_type: How stroking toys are exposed: as a dimmable light (voice friendly), as a precise number, or both.

no_toy_targets.message: Select at least one entity or device of a loaded Tether toy.

play_pattern.name: Play pattern
play_pattern.description: Plays a custom sequence of vibration strengths on the targeted toys.

pattern.name: Strength steps
pattern.description: Semicolon-separated strengths from 0 to 20, at most 50 steps.

interval.name: Step interval
interval.description: How long each step lasts, in milliseconds.

time_sec.name: Duration
time_sec.description: Total run time in seconds; 0 runs until stopped. Defaults to the configured default duration.

loop_running_sec.name: Loop running time
loop_running_sec.description: Seconds to run before each pause; 0 disables looping.

loop_pause_sec.name: Loop pause time
loop_pause_sec.description: Seconds to pause between loop runs.

play_preset.name: Play preset
play_preset.description: Runs a built-in Lovense preset on the targeted toys.

name.name: Preset
name.description: The built-in Lovense pattern to play.

time_sec.name: Duration
time_sec.description: Total run time in seconds; 0 runs until stopped. Defaults to the configured default duration.

send_function.name: Send function
send_function.description: Sends one or more validated Lovense function actions to the targeted toys.

action.name: Action
action.description: Comma-separated Function:level pairs, for example Vibrate:10,Rotate:5, or Stop.

time_sec.name: Duration
time_sec.description: Total run time in seconds; 0 runs until stopped. Defaults to the configured default duration.

loop_running_sec.name: Loop running time
loop_running_sec.description: Seconds to run before each pause; 0 disables looping.

loop_pause_sec.name: Loop pause time
loop_pause_sec.description: Seconds to pause between loop runs.

stop_previous.name: Stop previous commands
stop_previous.description: Stop any running command before starting this one.

stop_all.name: Stop all
stop_all.description: Immediately stops every function on the targeted toys.

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.description: Climbs to a peak vibration level, holds it, then decays back to off.

peak.name: Peak intensity
peak.description: Highest vibration level reached, from 1 to 20.

climb.name: Climb
climb.description: Seconds taken to reach the peak.

hold.name: Hold
hold.description: Seconds to stay at the peak.

decay.name: Decay
decay.description: Seconds taken to return to off.
